preconditions.description: Each reindeer name in the input list is composed of exactly two words.

postconditions.description: The output list has the same number of reindeer names as the input.

postconditions.expression: all(name in reindeer for name in sorted_reindeer)
postconditions.description: All names in the output list are present in the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted_reindeer[i].split()[1] <= sorted_reindeer[j].split()[1] for i in range(len(sorted_reindeer)) for j in range(i + 1, len(sorted_reindeer)))
postconditions.description: The reindeer names in the output list are sorted by their last names in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted_reindeer[i] == reindeer[j] for i in range(len(sorted_reindeer)) for j in range(len(reindeer)) if sorted_reindeer[i].split()[1] == reindeer[j].split()[1] and sorted_reindeer[i] == reindeer[j])
postconditions.description: For reindeer with identical last names, their original order in the input list is preserved in the output.
